conclusion_change.previous: A synthetic joke image acquired official evidentiary weight when its origin and context were lost in police handoffs. The newsroom then relied on the apparent authenticity of the police-supplied image, though it cropped the undercover officer. The real dog injury and the separate police correction remain distinct from this provenance failure. Police attributed the image to their own incident communications, which was a real supplying institution; the material error was loss of its synthetic creation state and non-evidentiary context, rather than a proven false attribution to a named creator. The synthetic state and joke context failed to persist through official handoff; source institution attribution and the genuine dog injury remain distinct. The officer crop is not automatically a C2PA assertion redaction. Unknown manifest implementation and voluntary Profile adoption limit external conclusions, without negating the established content-provenance failures.
